Devotion to the Caged Angel

You believe Uriel's Turning was a mercy the world flinched away from before it finished, and that a second, cleaner burning is still owed. You gain Cinders by committing violence in Uriel's name, recovering relics of the Turning, and feeding the belief — yours and others' — that the world must break again to be made right.

PRESENCE — enemies near you find their resolve harder to hold onto. Nothing dramatic. Just a little closer to breaking than they'd be otherwise.
